name: io.github.emiliaprotocol/mcp-server
title: Emilia Protocol
description: Exact-action approval for consequential agent actions: request, track, and verify signed receipts.

environmentVariables.name: EP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for live action-guard, signoff, and write operations. Public receipt lookup may work without it.

environmentVariables.name: EP_INCLUDE_PROTOCOL_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to advertise handshake, commit, and delegation tools in addition to the default three-tool action front door.

environmentVariables.name: EP_INCLUDE_REGISTRY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to advertise the complete 36-tool legacy registry and reputation catalog.
